decisions.reason: The source's requirement for smooth, non-aggressive high-speed mixing is already fully represented by the candidate's message-69 MODIFY.

The approved 5200 RPM maximum, prohibition on continuous maximum operation, and supported speed modes are already represented by the candidate's message-69 INTRODUCE; the splash-control change adds no further speed-control state.
The client mentions bowl-depth adjustment only as a conditional splash-mitigation option and does not change the current bowl depth or capacity.
A possible future adjustment to whisk position does not change the selected whisk design, material, or size requirement.
The source concerns splash control and mixing behavior at higher motor speeds, not dispensing flow, dripping, sputtering, or beverage preservation.
The splash-control decision does not affect the placard text, position, or viewing orientation.
The source does not change whether the spout is removable or its cleaning purpose.
The source does not alter any food-contact material selection.
The splash-control change does not modify the required wiring-plan deliverable or its detail level.
The source does not change the solenoid actuation mechanism or button-controlled dispensing behavior.
A conditional bowl-depth adjustment for splash mitigation does not necessarily change bowl removal or swapping behavior.
The higher-speed splash-control condition does not change the approved external power source or deferred battery option.
